application_process: Applicants can download the application form from www.kswdc.com or obtain it from the Deputy Director/CDPO offices. The completed form and required documents must be submitted to the nearest bank or KSFC branch for verification, approval, and disbursement.
benefits: For SC/ST women, a subsidy of 50% on loan unit costs between ₹1,00,000 and ₹3,00,000. For general and special category women, a subsidy of 30% (up to ₹90,000) on unit costs up to ₹3,00,000, along with EDP training.
description: Udyogini is an innovative scheme by the Government of Karnataka designed to assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment. It provides subsidies on loans from the Karnataka State Women’s Development Corporation for undertaking business activities and micro-enterprises.
documents_required: Three passport-size photographs, Certificate regarding training/experience of the activity, Detailed Project Report (DPR), Ration Card / Voter ID Card, Annual Income Certificate of the Family, Caste Certificate (for SC/ST), Quotations for Machinery, Equipment, and other Capital Expenses.
eligibility: The applicant must be a woman, a permanent resident of Karnataka, aged between 18 and 55 years, and must not have defaulted on any past loans. The family income must be below ₹1,50,000 for general/special categories, and below ₹2,00,000 for SC/ST categories (no income limit for widowed or disabled women).
objective: To assist women in gaining self-reliance and economic independence through self-employment, mainly through trade and the service sector.

application_process: 1. Fill out the application form on the official website. 2. Print the completed application form. 3. Submit the printed form and required documents to the Selection Panel of the concerned district. 4. Upon approval, the subsidy will be transferred to the bank account.
benefits: A loan of ₹50,000 at a 4% interest rate to be repaid in 36 installments, with a 50% back-end subsidy upon timely repayment of half the loan, and training in artistic and technical skills.
description: A scheme in Karnataka providing religious minority community entrepreneurs with training in artistic and technical skills along with a loan of ₹50,000 at a 4% interest rate. Repaying 50% of the loan within 36 months waives the remaining 50% as a back-end subsidy.
documents_required: Print out of the completely filled online application form, Beneficiary's latest 2 passport size photos, Caste and income certificate, Copy of the Aadhaar card, Project report of the business, Copy of the Bank Passbook, Self-Declaration Form, Self-Declaration Form from Surety.
eligibility: Applicants must be permanent residents of Karnataka, belong to a State Religious Minority Community, and be aged between 18 and 55 years. The annual family income must be within ₹3.50 lakh. Applicants or family members must not have benefited from other KMDCL schemes (except Arivu) in the last 5 years, must not be government/PSU employees, and must not be loan defaulters in KMDC.
objective: To train religious minority community entrepreneurs in artistic and technical skills and provide them with financial assistance.

application_process: Offline: Step 1: Visit the official Madilu Programme website or the nearest Rural Development Office to obtain the application form. Step 2: Fill out the application form with the required personal details, including contact information and relevant skills or areas of interest. Step 3: Attach any supporting documents or certificates related to previous skills or entrepreneurial experience, if applicable. Step 4: Submit the completed application form along with the supporting documents to the designated Rural Development Office or the specified submission location. Step 5: The application will be reviewed by the selection committee, and eligible candidates will be shortlisted. Step 6: Shortlisted candidates may be called for an interview or additional assessment to determine their suitability for the program. Step 7: Successful applicants will be notified of their acceptance into the Madilu Programme and provided with further instructions on the program commencement and orientation.
benefits: Empowerment of rural communities through skill development and entrepreneurship. Creation of sustainable livelihoods and reduction of poverty. Enhancement of social and economic well-being in rural areas. Increased income-generating opportunities for participants. Access to micro-financing options and market linkages. Promotion of gender equality and social inclusion. Strengthening of rural economies and local industries.
description: The Madilu Programme is a comprehensive initiative implemented by the government to uplift rural communities by providing them with the necessary skills and resources to improve their livelihoods. The program primarily focuses on skill development, entrepreneurship, and capacity building. By equipping individuals with relevant skills, it aims to create sustainable income-generating opportunities within rural areas.
documents_required: Completed application form, Personal identification documents (e.g., Aadhaar card, passport, or voter ID), Proof of residence (e.g., utility bill, ration card, or land ownership document), Educational certificates or qualifications (if applicable), Certificates or documentation showcasing previous skills or entrepreneurial experience (if applicable), Income certificate or proof of income (if required for specific program benefits), Any other supporting documents relevant to the application or specific program requirements.
eligibility: Individuals residing in rural areas are eligible to participate. Participants should have a willingness to learn and engage in skill development activities. There is no age restriction for participation in the program. Both men and women are encouraged to apply. Participants should demonstrate an interest in entrepreneurship and improving their livelihoods.
objective: To uplift rural communities by providing them with the necessary skills and resources to improve their livelihoods, focusing on skill development, entrepreneurship, and capacity building.
